product_summary: VA Tech Wabag (WABAG), Chennai — pure-play water technology EPC/DBO/BOT company. Real product/service lines per own website (wabag.com): drinking water treatment plants; desalination (membrane RO, thermal MED/MD, electrodialysis, ion exchange demineralisation); wastewater treatment; industrial water treatment (clarification OPUR-SK, filtration, CERAMOPUR/CERAMOZONE membrane filtration, CARBOPUR/PACOPUR adsorption, ADOX/BIOZONE oxidation, MED/RO/ENR/MD-ZEROPUR desalination, condensate polishing, boiler feed water demineralisation); effluent treatment; sludge treatment / anaerobic digestion (70+ plants since 1995, >30 MW green energy); water reclamation & reuse, industrial water recycling, ZLD, potable reuse (TTRO); Bio-CNG/biogas upgrading, compression & storage; high-purity water solutions. Delivery model is turnkey plants + O&M, not sale of discrete goods.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader (EPC/system integrator and technology provider; equipment largely procured and integrated, not own-factory mass production) — no trader-only signs, but also not a plain goods manufacturer
comment: HS mismatch, company retained per Rule 3 (HS mismatch never rejects). Declared codes 4009.42 (rubber tubes with fittings), 4010.31/4010.32 (rubber conveyor belts) and 7206.10 (iron/steel ingots) do not correspond to anything in WABAG's catalogue — no rubber hose, conveyor belting or steel ingot line appears anywhere on wabag.com. These look like a supplier-declaration error or a copy of another party's lines; status: wrong. Correct mapping of the actual offering: water/wastewater treatment plants and desalination units -> 8421.21 (water filtering/purifying machinery) and 8421.29 (other liquid filtering/purifying); complete treatment/desalination plant packages and evaporation/thermal units -> 8419.39 / 8419.40 / 8419.89; sludge anaerobic digestion, biogas and Bio-CNG upgrading/compression packages -> 8479.89 (and 8414.80 for gas compressors); pumps -> 8413.50/8413.70/8413.81; valves -> 8481.80; tanks/vessels -> 7309.00; control panels/automation -> 8537.10; instrumentation -> 9026.10/9032.89; membranes and filter elements -> 8421.99; ion-exchange resins -> 3824.99; chemicals (chlorine, hypochlorite, disinfectants, catalysts) -> 2807.00/2828.90/3808.94/3815.19. Industry classification 'Авиастроение и транспорт' (aviation & transport) is clearly wrong — the company is water infrastructure / environmental engineering (municipal and industrial utilities), not aviation or transport. Product lines entirely missing from the declaration: desalination, wastewater/effluent treatment, ZLD, sludge digestion, Bio-CNG, water reuse, O&M services. All of the above is corroborated only by the company's own website (wabag.com offering pages: /industrial-water-treatment/, /desalination/, /sludge-treatment/, /bio-cng/) — no customs line was available to this researcher, therefore the actual shipment-level HS codes are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' and the list above is an inferred mapping, not a verified customs record. Revenue, export volumes and shipment records were not researched (out of scope for this role).
